method: auditor3 independent: numpy slabs (+-0.5/0.6 mm) perpendicular to each gold line at 19 stations; legs from vertex normals, two skins split, outer/inner virtual sharps, outer apex = first surface hit along bisector from outer sharp; apex line = PCA of apex points; fold extent = 1 mm march along apex line requiring apex points + both legs. Drawing 38172000_01.pdf (both sheets) read for bend inventory.
part: ISAC EtherCAT PS tray, AL5052 1.5 mm: main plate + 2 side flanges (B01,B02) + end flange (B07) + Z-step (B03,B05) + shelf with return flange (B04) and 2 side flanges (missing) + 2 formed tabs (B09,B10) = 10 bends, matching sender count 10

B01.note: main-plate side flange (13.5 mm), 92 deg, R_o~2.6; gold on outer apex full length; ends 2 mm past fold end at step

B02.note: main-plate side flange, 91.5 deg; on outer apex

B03.note: step lower bend (joggle bend 1), 91.4 deg; on outer apex; ~2 mm overrun each end

B04.note: shelf return flange (15 mm), 92 deg; on outer arc within 1 mm of apex

B05.note: step upper bend (joggle bend 2), 91 deg, R_o~2.7, t=1.5. Gold is +2.43..+2.54 mm along the bisector toward the CONCAVE side, lateral <0.22 mm: sits on the bend axis (arc centre), ~1.0 mm off the inner skin in free air; 1.55 mm from inner virtual sharp, 3.7 mm from outer virtual sharp. Parallel (0.07 deg), full length, constant: a bend-axis locus convention, not the outer virtual sharp. Within frozen 4 mm.

B06.note: vertical 15 mm line in the open corner-relief notch between the shelf return flange (B04) and the shelf left side flange; both flanges end separately (end faces visible, ~2x2 mm notch), no fold. Line is 90 deg to the real small fold it presumably meant (shelf left side flange, missing). 1.0-1.6 mm from nearest surface (in air).

B07.note: main-plate end flange (13.5 mm, opposite the step), 92 deg. Gold +2.63..+2.88 mm along bisector toward CONCAVE side (bend-axis depth, same family as B05) but skewed 0.69 deg so lateral drift 0.0->2.2 mm; ends 2.7/3.9 mm from apex. Gold spans full part width 225.5 mm while fold is 202 mm (flange ends at corner reliefs, X=-101.6..100.4): overruns ~11.5 and ~12 mm into reliefs/side flanges. Imprecise but within frozen matcher (3.06 mm, 0.69 deg, 90% overlap).

B08.note: mirror of B06 at the right shelf corner: open corner notch between B04 return flange end (X~110) and right side-flange end (Y~116.8); no fold; 90 deg to the missing right side-flange fold.

B09.note: formed tab main fold (drawing 78.62), 92 deg; gold on outer arc surface ~1 mm lateral of apex (0.1-0.2 mm from scan); fold Y=-65.3..13.5, gold -63.8..11.6

B10.note: second formed tab main fold, 92 deg; on outer arc ~0.9 mm lateral of apex

missing_bends.desc: shelf LEFT side flange (drawing Section D-D "15 BOTH SIDES", PEM holes at 16.5/38.5): fold along Y at X=-112.4, Z~30 (shelf level), 91.5 deg, ~44 mm long (Y 73.0..117.0)
shelf RIGHT side flange (mirror), fold along Y at X=111.6, 92.7 deg, ~44 mm (Y 73.0..117.0)

Drawing/sender count treat each tab as ONE bend; only counts if every small formed fold is labelled.
